items.title: Customize generated SDK shapes and names for private networking
items.summary: Add AutoRest/C# flattening, C# alternate resource-reference types and names, and JavaScript names for the new API versions. Exclude JavaScript from AssociationUpdate.properties flattening; this affects the existing Association update payload's SDK presentation, not its ARM wire lifecycle. Its JavaScript compatibility remains evidence-limited.

inferenceResults.rationale: AutoRest-only flattening targets the newly introduced PrivateEndpointConnection and PrivateLinkResource properties. No pre-existing property is removed or retyped by this hunk; the new resources are version-gated additions.
JavaScript clientName augmentations only name the newly added 2025-10-01-preview and 2026-03-01 enum members. Existing version member names and wire values are untouched.

AssociationUpdate.properties stops applying legacy flattening to JavaScript. The wire property remains optional AssociationUpdateProperties, but no before/after JavaScript public-surface evidence is supplied to establish whether callers previously used flattened members. This language-specific SDK compatibility effect cannot be resolved from the language-neutral snapshot.

The C# alternate types, flattening and client names target newly introduced private-endpoint/private-link models, frontend association IDs, public network access and private connection status types. These source-linked additions do not replace an existing baseline member; unrelated prior C# customizations remain unchanged.

items.title: Add private frontends, private endpoint connections and private link discovery
items.summary: Append 2025-10-01-preview and 2026-03-01, propagating version-gated networking additions into the new stable API. Add optional frontend access/association settings and TrafficController private endpoint references. New TrafficController child ProxyResources expose connection read, synchronous create-or-replace, asynchronous delete and parent-list operations, plus private-link read/list discovery. Artifact comparison projects current source at 2025-01-01 and 2026-03-01.
